question: Is forced sensory withdrawal a true release from bondage?
premises: There is a so-called withdrawal applied to the net of the senses.
When bondage is already firmly established, such withdrawal is imposed on it.
That imposed withdrawal becomes a binding like diamond cement.
inference: Forced pratyāhāra, applied over established bondage, strengthens bondage rather than removing it.
plain_english: Even that so-called withdrawal which is applied to the net of the senses becomes, for one whose bondage is already firmly set, a binding as hard as diamond cement.
